text.en:
The Presidential Appointments Office shall be headed by a senior official of
appropriate rank and shall be under the supervision and control of the Presidential Chief of Staff.

All orders, rules, regulations and issuances, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent
with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Mani1a, this~
day of March 2006.
